note: The period (5 years) is supported by secondary sources for the bookkeeping act. The start point differs between sources: end of the financial year, or the document date. v0.1 uses FISCAL_YEAR_END and lists RECORD_DATE as the open alternative (CHANGELOG F-DK-4). The paragraph of the act is not confirmed. Snapshot rules are never shorter than the ledger rule (12, 4.1 consistency rule). READ_LOG is a platform design default, not law

defaults.legal_basis: Bogføringsloven (lov nr. 700 af 24/05/2022), opbevaring. Paragraf ikke bekræftet
